title: Add Frog and Toad Yoto/audiobook playlist
description: Host the licensed Frog and Toad MP3s on the blog, expose them in the existing Waves player as an audiobook playlist, provide a Yoto helper/download page for offline MYO setup, and keep any streaming RSS fallback clearly secondary.
close_reason: Implemented Frog and Toad audiobook hosting, Waves playlist, Yoto setup page, RSS fallback, and browser/test verification.

title: Extract PlayerControls sub-component
description: Create src/components/player/PlayerControls.astro with shuffle, prev, play/pause, next, repeat buttons and all SVG icons. Component receives button IDs as props.

title: Extract lyrics parser utility
description: Create src/utils/lyrics-parser.ts moving parseLyrics(), parseTimestamp(), isTimestamp(), escapeHtml() from MusicPlayer.astro frontmatter. Add proper TypeScript types.

title: Extract TypeScript types for music player
description: Create src/scripts/music-player/types.ts with all TypeScript interfaces: Track, LyricLine, ParsedLyrics, PlayerState, MusicPlayerAPI. These will be shared across all modules.

title: Extract ProgressBar sub-component
description: Create src/components/player/ProgressBar.astro with range input slider and current/duration time displays.

title: Create queue manager module
description: Create src/scripts/music-player/queue-manager.ts with: loadTrack(), playNext(), playPrevious(), toggleShuffle(), toggleRepeat(), switchGenre(). Include Fisher-Yates shuffle algorithm.

title: Create keyboard shortcuts module
description: Create src/scripts/music-player/keyboard-shortcuts.ts with global keydown handler for: Space (play/pause), Arrow keys (volume/track), M (mute), G (genre), S (shuffle), R (repeat), ? (help), / (terminal), Escape.

title: Create audio controller module
description: Create src/scripts/music-player/audio-controller.ts wrapping HTMLAudioElement: play(), pause(), seek(), setVolume(), getCurrentTime(), getDuration(). Handle timeupdate, ended, loadedmetadata events.

title: Fix Yoto podcast RSS chapter validation
description: Yoto rejects the Frog and Toad podcast RSS chapters as invalid. Make the RSS feed validator-clean and podcast-compatible.
close_reason: Fixed RSS feed structure for Yoto podcast validation

title: Fix Yoto podcast chapter validation
description: Yoto accepted the Frog and Toad RSS feed but rejected every converted chapter during Save. Add complete podcast item metadata and verify the generated RSS.
close_reason: Added complete podcast metadata to the Frog and Toad RSS feed, updated setup instructions, and verified tests/build.

title: Improve playlist selector and expose Yoto feed directory
description: Make the Waves playlist selector a vertical scrollable list, normalize mobile player control sizing, and add an on-site directory of Yoto playlist RSS/setup URLs.
close_reason: Implemented vertical playlist selector, mobile control sizing fixes, and Yoto feed directory.

title: Fix range responses for all audio assets
description: Some music assets ignore Range requests (206 missing). Ensure all audio assets are served with Accept-Ranges and content-length from the same cacheable origin; align buckets/CDN config and re-upload as needed.
close_reason: Fixed by bypassing middleware for static audio asset paths so byte-range responses are preserved by the static origin.

title: Confirm licenses before hosting commercial Archive audiobooks
description: The requested Archive.org batch included Roald Dahl, Dr. Seuss, and Grow Up recordings whose metadata did not show redistribution rights; Grow Up explicitly says all rights reserved. Only host these on jval.dev after confirming a license or permission to redistribute publicly.
notes: User confirmed licenses for the remaining requested Archive.org sources, so the licensing blocker is cleared.

title: Extract HotkeysModal sub-component
description: Create src/components/player/HotkeysModal.astro with keyboard shortcuts help modal and backdrop click-to-close handling.

title: Create lyrics sync module
description: Create src/scripts/music-player/lyrics-sync.ts with: syncLyrics(currentTime), loadLyrics(trackTitle, genre), updateScrollPosition(). Handle timestamp-based highlighting and proportional scroll fallback.

title: Refactor MusicPlayer.astro to use extracted modules
description: Refactor MusicPlayer.astro to import all sub-components and external TypeScript modules. Target: reduce from 2366 lines to ~150 lines of composition logic only.

title: Extract LyricsPanel sub-component
description: Create src/components/player/LyricsPanel.astro with lyrics container and scroll progress track indicator.

title: Create music player orchestrator module
description: Create src/scripts/music-player/index.ts that initializes all modules, wires up DOM event handlers, and exports window.musicPlayerAPI for Terminal integration. This is the main entry point.

title: Add Beatrix Potter Yoto audiobook hosting
description: Host The Great Big Treasury of Beatrix Potter plus the clear-license Archive.org additions on jval.dev with Yoto-ready RSS feeds, setup pages, and Waves playlist entries. Also file follow-up work for requested commercial/no-license Archive items that require redistribution confirmation.
close_reason: Implemented Beatrix Potter, Little Red Riding Hood, and Uncle Wiggily Yoto hosting with verified RSS feeds, setup pages, Waves playlist entries, and mirrored MP3 assets.

title: Create centralized state management for music player
description: Create src/scripts/music-player/state.ts with centralized PlayerState: currentIndex, currentGenre, shuffleEnabled, repeatMode, volume, isPlaying. Include event emitter for state changes.

title: Extract VolumeControl sub-component
description: Create src/components/player/VolumeControl.astro with volume blocks UI and percentage display. Receives initial volume as prop.

title: Verify music player refactoring
description: Verify all functionality works after refactoring: build passes, play/pause, next/prev, shuffle, repeat, genre switch, lyrics sync, keyboard shortcuts, volume control, seek, URL track loading, terminal API.

title: Align GitHub Actions with local CI commands
close_reason: Aligned GitHub Actions with Makefile/mise CI targets.

title: Extract QueueList sub-component
description: Create src/components/player/QueueList.astro with track list, genre toggle buttons (Hip-Hop/Country), and genre icons (mic/lasso SVGs). Receives tracks data as prop.
